messages:
maria: Quick sync — follow-up from the authz postmortem. We keep seeing token validation failures spike during rotation windows and a few permissions drift cases. Need explicit owners, timelines, and a cadence for rotations + audit log fixes.

cheng: I'll own the token validation work. I'll open a ticket and do an initial triage. ETA for triage doc: end of week.

dylan: I'll take audit logging — add missing event types and verify retention. Planning to coordinate with infra for log shipping.

sara: On rotations: current app key rotation is every 30d which clashes with our deploy freeze windows. Proposing we move to 45d for app keys and 7d for ephemeral tokens. Also need a tested rollback for KMS key swap.

maria: Please post concrete action items here with owners + due dates and whether it's config-only or requires deploy. Also note any monitoring/alerts to add.

cheng: Triage ticket created: INC-2346 -> https://redwood/jira/INC-2346. Scope: reproduce validation failure, add metrics, create safe rollback path. Owner: cheng. Due: 2025-04-04. Config vs deploy: config + small runtime patch (can hotfix).

dylan: JIRA-4591 created: https://redwood/jira/JIRA-4591. Fixes: ensure events token.create/token.rotate/perm.change are emitted, wire to ELK pipeline, bump retention to 90d for token events. Owner: dylan. Due: 2025-04-11. Requires infra coord (log sink).

sara: Drafting rotation proposal doc: https://docs.internal/rotations/proposal (WIP). Proposed crons:
```
# ephemeral tokens - weekly at 03:00
0 3 * * 1
# app keys - monthly on day 1 at 04:00
0 4 1 * *
```
Will need ops approval and a staging run. Owner: sara. Draft due: 2025-03-30.

ops-bot: Reminder: infra on-call rotation starts tomorrow @oncall-infra :bell:

alice: Suggest adding an automated nightly privilege-drift scan (compare IAM vs. expected roles). I can prototype a scanner and a one-click remediation flow. Owner: alice. Ticket PROTO-72. Proto due: 2025-03-28.

kevin: I'll create a recurring calendar invite for weekly follow-ups and add a 'recurrence pattern' + 'previous incidents' column to the remediation tracker so we can surface repeat offenders. Will also add an ownership column. ETA: 2025-03-27.

cheng: Also adding a metric + alert: `auth.token.validation.latency.p95`. Alert when p95 > 250ms during rotation window. I'll add to dashboards and create runbook entry.

sara: We should also schedule a staged KMS rotation test in canary before changing cron. I'll coordinate with security and infra.

maria: Summary of action items: 
- INC-2346 (cheng) — token validation triage + rollback, due 2025-04-04, patch/hotfix
- JIRA-4591 (dylan) — audit log event coverage + retention, due 2025-04-11, infra coord
- PROTO-72 (alice) — privilege-drift scanner prototype, due 2025-03-28
- Rotation proposal draft (sara) — cron + KMS test plan, due 2025-03-30
- Calendar + remediation tracker updates (kevin) — due 2025-03-27

Recurring cadence: weekly follow-up on Tuesdays 10:00 PST until items closed. Please update tickets with progress and mark blockers. Ping me if anyone needs a pairing session. :eyes:
